predictions.falsifier: state-utility plant, or single-unit plant, or unit below 200 MW, or the whole plant stays shut beyond a week

predictions.claim: the affected unit stays offline for months (at least 3): a boiler explosion damages pressure parts and waterwalls that need replacement, not repair
predictions.carrier: CEA daily outage reports, owner statements, regional press on restart

evidence.title: 13 killed, 21 injured in boiler blast at Vedanta plant in Chhattisgarh (Business Standard, 14 Apr 2026)
evidence.excerpt: At least 13 workers killed and 21 injured after a steam-carrying tube connected to a boiler exploded at a Vedanta Ltd power plant in Singhitarai village, Sakti district, around 2:30 pm. Blast in the tube supplying high-pressure steam from the boiler to the turbine at Unit-1 of the company's Athena power plant. Affected personnel employed by NGSL, the O&M subcontractor. Magisterial inquiry ordered; PM ex-gratia announced.
evidence.note: identity of plant, owner, unit, contractor; casualties among contract workers

evidence.title: Death toll from boiler explosion at Vedanta's India coal plant rises to 24, triggers probes (POWER, ~20 Apr 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Vedanta Limited Chhattisgarh Thermal Power Plant, Singhitarai: two 600-MW supercritical units; Unit 1 entered commercial operation mid-2025; Unit 2 under construction at the time of the explosion. Death toll 24 by April 19. Investigators found excessive accumulation of coal fuel in the Boiler 1 furnace; operators continued running the unit despite repeated PA fan malfunctions, ramping 350 to 590 MW. Criminal FIR; magisterial inquiry (30 days); seven-member Central Boiler Board expert team.
evidence.note: falsifies the map sub-claim that the plant keeps running on other units: Unit 2 was not built

evidence.title: Vedanta shares fall as FIR filed against Anil Agarwal, others in boiler blast case (Business Today, 17 Apr 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Vedanta shares gained 1.79% on April 15 and 2.19% on April 16 (commentary attributes the rise to the demerger and global metal prices). On April 17 the stock fell 1.39% to a low of Rs 771.85 on BSE after an FIR was registered at Dabhra police station naming eight to ten individuals including group chairman Anil Agarwal under BNS s.106, s.289 and s.3(5). No analyst commentary on the outage's financial impact.
evidence.note: owner equity: day-after move positive and not attributed; attributed dip on FIR day is 1.4%, below the 2% falsifier

evidence.title: Athena Chhattisgarh power station (Global Energy Monitor wiki)
evidence.excerpt: Originally Athena Energy Ventures (Athena Projects, PTC India, IDFC). In July 2022 Vedanta Limited acquired Athena Chhattisgarh Power Limited for Rs 5.65 billion to meet its captive power requirements. Unit 1 (600 MW supercritical) began operating July 2025; Unit 2 expected July 2027. In November 2025 Vedanta secured a PPA from Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation to supply 200 MW from the plant, 2026 to 2031, at Rs 5.38/kWh. No boiler or turbine OEM named.
evidence.note: ownership and offtake structure; OEM not identifiable from retrieved sources

evidence.title: IEX power trade surges 16.6% in April 2026 amid rising demand and market volatility (SolarQuarter, 6 May 2026)
evidence.excerpt: April 2026: DAM average clearing price Rs 5.26/unit (+1% YoY); peak demand record 256 GW; shift from unseasonal rain to summer heat drove usage; early-month prices below Rs 3.5/unit; RTM prices near zero on solar surplus days. No generating unit outage, Vedanta, Chhattisgarh or boiler incident is mentioned anywhere as a price driver. Business Standard's IEX April report likewise attributes prices to demand and weather.
evidence.note: exchange price call: no attributable step

evidence.title: Vedanta demerger: trading of 4 new companies on NSE, BSE commences June 15, 2026 (Angel One)
evidence.excerpt: Vedanta's demerged entities, including Vedanta Power, began trading on BSE and NSE on June 15, 2026. Vedanta Power is described as India's fifth-largest thermal producer with 4.2 GW operational capacity. Sakti's 600 MW is roughly 14% of that capacity, and the Q1 FY27 EBITDA decline of 30% was attributed to the Sakti outage; Vedanta Power shares declined ahead of its first standalone results (Upstox, 30 Jul 2026).
evidence.note: a listed power pure-play with concentrated exposure emerged two months after the event by corporate action, not by the event

evidence.title: Vedanta Power Q1 FY27 results and earnings call (30 Jul 2026; ANI, SaurEnergy, Investing.com transcript)
evidence.excerpt: Sakti asset temporarily shut down since April 14, 2026 following a critical boiler blast in Unit-I. Sakti sales 465 MU in Q1 FY27 vs 1,087 MU in Q4 FY26 on reduced availability. Vedanta Power EBITDA down 30% YoY to Rs 291 crore due to the boiler incident, despite revenue +31% and volumes +38%. Management expects Sakti Unit 1 to restart by end of Q2 FY27 and Unit 2 to be commissioned by end FY27. First results after the demerger; 4.2 GW operational.
evidence.note: outage duration at least 5.5 months (April 14 to end-September guidance); the event shows in the owner cash-flow layer

evidence.title: Absence record: no jurisdiction-wide inspection order found within 14 days (searched 7 Sep 2026); NGT all-plant audit order dates from 2020
evidence.excerpt: English-language national, trade and regional coverage (POWER, HazardEx, Chemindigest, Statesman, National Herald, Akashvani) records probes of the plant itself only: CM-ordered state probe, magisterial inquiry by SDM Dabhra (30 days), Central Boiler Board seven-member team, criminal FIR. No state factories department, Directorate of Boilers or court order to inspect or audit other plants by April 28, 2026 was found. The NGT all-plant audit order cited dates from 22 Dec 2020 (Neyveli).
evidence.note: negative evidence for the inspection-order call; Hindi-language orders not searched

resolutions.scorer_note: operator-cutoff flag: Q2 fails for claude-fable-5-1 (cutoff 2026-06-30); operator reports no specific recall of this event; self-scored, human to ratify. Map: private owner (Vedanta Ltd) right, Dabhra cluster right, 600 MW unit right, contract-worker casualties right (NGSL, toll 24) but the load-bearing sub-claim failed: Unit 2 was under construction, so the plant did not keep running; falsifier fired. Miss classified as misread (map fact), not mechanism.
Unit shut from 14 Apr; still shut at the 30 Jul results; restart guided for end Q2 FY27, i.e. 5.5 months. Baseline (back in weeks) wrong.
April DAM Rs 5.26, +1% YoY, attributed entirely to weather and demand; no source mentions the outage. Cut into slack was silent.

Probes of the plant itself (magisterial, state, Central Boiler Board, FIR) but no order to inspect or audit peer plants found by April 28 in English-language coverage; the NGT all-plant audit order dates from 2020. Falsifier fired. Search limitation: Hindi-language state orders not checked. The new candidate rule proposed at lock takes its first miss.
A 200 MW PPA with TNPDCL existed from Feb 2026, so a shortfall notice is likely, but no public record of an availability or force majeure notice was found. Unverified, as flagged at lock.

Ordering held: physical (unit out 5+ months, Sakti sales -57% QoQ) > owner cash flow (segment EBITDA -30% YoY) > coal (silent, unverified) > grid prices (nil) > equity (+1.8%/+2.2%/-1.4%, not attributable beyond the FIR-day dip). Baseline (everything moves on the day) wrong.

Null hit, weight 0.2. Day-after move +1.79%, attributed to demerger and metal prices; the only attributed move was -1.39% on the FIR (day 3), under the 2% threshold. Baseline (owner down) wrong: owner went up. No OEM, insurer or coal-supplier move found.

Scored strictly against the pre-registered falsifier, which fired: a listed holder with concentrated exposure (Vedanta Power, ~14% of capacity, EBITDA -30% on the outage) emerged on 15 Jun 2026 by demerger. The gate did fail at event time, so the mechanism was right; the miss is a falsifier drafted without a time bound. Weight 0.2. Baseline (trade the disruption): no evidence it would have paid; unverified. Human may supersede.
Boiler OEM could not be identified from retrieved sources (GEM, project pages, press), so the OEM-equity carrier could not be checked. Unverified.
